article.title: French Youth Rise Up Against Racism, Austerity, and the Rising Right Wing
article.author: bareditors
article.content: French Youth Rise Up Against Racism, Austerity, and the Rising Right Wing Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 10/09/2026 - 04:55 Students in France are engaging in mass protests. Hundreds of them have been arrested and injured by police, and many schools are closed. Annick Metefia joins us from Paris. She is a member of the Afrofeminist Mwasi Collectif and provides insights on politics and the struggles of African-descended and other immigrant communities under an austerity regime and the rise of the racist right wing.
